name: cpsc_slide_projection
what: Slide projection gauge: a projection that fits one of the three ring gauges must not stand taller than the gauge's thickness above the surrounding surface.
source: CPSC Handbook (July 2025) Figure B2 and test B.2.3. The drawing is a plan view, so 1/8 in being the thickness is inferred from the B.2.3 text.
